name: Symplectic Geometry

papers.title: Equivariant cohomology of stacky Lie group actions
papers.abstract: In this work we introduce equivariant cohomology for Lie groupoids and differentiable stacks. For Lie groupoids equipped with a strict action of a Lie 2-group, we define the corresponding equivariant cohomology via the Borel model and establish its Morita invariance. We also construct a simplicial Cartan model and prove that, under standard compactness assumptions, it recovers the equivariant cohomology defined via the Borel model. In the framework of stacky Lie group actions, we show that if a connected and \'etale stacky Lie group acts on a differentiable stack admitting an equivariant atlas, then the stacky action admits a strict presentation by a Lie 2-group action. Furthermore, we prove that different choices of equivariant atlases yield equivariantly Morita equivalent presenting actions, giving rise to a well-defined notion of equivariant cohomology for differentiable stacks. As an application, we compute the equivariant cohomology of toric symplectic stacks.
